{{Top|leg}}
'''Cartel Central''' was a group of offices located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Joventusek]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], which served as a base of operations for the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Caarite]]s [[Jyll Xon]] and [[Patla Soo]] both worked in the offices.
